opening.argument: The video is centered on observable tennis instruction: its title identifies Maria Sharapova performing “Forehand and Backhand” in super slow motion, and the description presents footage of her “hitting her forehand, and backhand.” Its promotional material offers a free forehand masterclass to help viewers improve their tennis, while the end screen invites viewers to click for additional slow-motion footage of Nadal, Federer, and Djokovic and to subscribe to Essential Tennis. These are ordinary educational resources and channel-engagement requests tied directly to additional tennis content, supporting a general news, lifestyle, and entertainment presentation rather than deceptive conduct.
